faults.quote: If you shift it to the first syllable (άργος), it becomes a different word
faults.why: Modern Greek has no common adjective 'άργος' (Άργος is a city); 'idle/vacant' is also αργός.

faults.quote: Not active; lazy or avoiding work.
faults.why: Archaic/set-phrase sense ('idle'); in modern speech αργός στη δουλειά means 'slow at work', not 'lazy'.
